Buildings.name: Buildings

IDEAS.name: IDEAS

templates.material:
record {{ construction.name }} = IDEAS.Buildings.Data.Interfaces.Material (
      k={{ construction.thermal_conductivity }},
      c={{ construction.specific_heat_capacity }},
      rho={{ construction.density }},
{% if construction.kind == "gas" %}
      epsLw={{ construction.longwave_emissivity }},
      epsSw={{ construction.shortwave_emissivity }},
      gas=true
{%- elif construction.kind == "glass" %}
      epsLw={{ construction.infrared_absorptivity_room_facing }},
      epsLw_a={{ construction.infrared_absorptivity_room_facing }},
      epsLw_b={{ construction.infrared_absorptivity_outside_facing }},
      epsSw={{ construction.shortwave_emissivity }},
      glass=true
{%- else %}
      epsLw={{ construction.longwave_emissivity }},
      epsSw={{ construction.shortwave_emissivity }}
{%- endif %});

templates.glazing:
{%- set panes = construction.layers | selectattr('layer_type', 'eq', 'glass') | list -%}
{%- set gaps = construction.layers | selectattr('layer_type', 'eq', 'gas') | list -%}
{%- set properties = construction.properties -%}
{#- a single pane has no gap: an empty array constructor {} is not valid Modelica -#}
{%- macro array(values) -%}{%- set values = values | list -%}{% if values %}{ {{- values | map('mo') | join(', ') -}} }{% else %}fill(0.0, 0){% endif %}{%- endmacro -%}
record {{ construction.name }} = {{ package_name }}.FastModel.Data.Glazing(
    nPan={{ panes | length }},
    x={{ array(panes | map(attribute='thickness')) }},
    k={{ array(panes | map(attribute='material.thermal_conductivity')) }},
    d={ {%- for pane in panes %}{{ pane.material.density }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    c={ {%- for pane in panes %}{{ pane.material.specific_heat_capacity or 0 }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    xGas={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='thickness')) }},
    kGas={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='material.thermal_conductivity')) }},
    muGas_a={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='material.viscosity_coefficients.0')) }},
    muGas_b={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='material.viscosity_coefficients.1')) }},
    cGas={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='material.specific_heat_capacity')) }},
    MGas={{ array(gaps | map(attribute='material.molar_mass')) }},
    epsGap_a={{ array(panes[:-1] | map(attribute='material.infrared_absorptivity_room_facing')) }},
    epsGap_b={{ array(panes[1:] | map(attribute='material.infrared_absorptivity_outside_facing')) }},
    tau={ {{- properties.optics.transmittance.tolist() | map('mo') | join(', ') -}} },
    absPan={ {%- for row in properties.optics.absorptances.tolist() %}{ {{- row | map('mo') | join(', ') -}} }{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    absIR_a={{ panes[0].material.infrared_absorptivity_outside_facing }},
    absIR_b={{ panes[-1].material.infrared_absorptivity_room_facing }},
    UFra={{ construction.u_value_frame }}) "{{ construction.name }}";

templates.construction:
{#- one sublayer a layer: a node at each layer boundary -#}
record {{ construction.name }} = {{ package_name }}.FastModel.Data.Construction(
    nLay={{ construction.layers | length }},
    x={ {{- construction.layers | map(attribute='thickness') | join(', ') -}} },
    k={ {%- for layer in construction.layers %}{{ layer.material.thermal_conductivity }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    c={ {%- for layer in construction.layers %}{{ layer.material.specific_heat_capacity }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    d={ {%- for layer in construction.layers %}{{ layer.material.density }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    nSta={ {%- for layer in construction.layers %}1{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    nNod={{ construction.layers | length }},
    lay={ {%- for layer in construction.layers %}{{ loop.index }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor -%} },
    absIR_a={{ construction.layers[0].material.longwave_emissivity }},
    absIR_b={{ construction.layers[-1].material.longwave_emissivity }},
    absSol_a={{ construction.layers[0].material.shortwave_emissivity }},
    absSol_b={{ construction.layers[-1].material.shortwave_emissivity }}) "{{ construction.name }}";
